rules.direct_v1: Transcribe a source classification or faithful paraphrase at its reported region/life stage; no transfer to other contexts.
rules.estuary_sea_v1: Explicit seasonal or life-stage movement between estuary and offshore marine waters maps to project category oceano-estuarine. This is a project interpretation, not a source-assigned FishBase category; no freshwater route is implied.
rules.marine_seasonal_v1: Explicit seasonal/spawning migration within marine waters maps to project category oceanodromous, restricted to the reported region/life stage. Diel foraging alone, distribution records, larval drift or speculative movements do not qualify.
rules.hold_v1: Retain source evidence without promoting it to a summary classification when tentative, context/vocabulary unresolved, or taxon transfer unverified.
